import re

content = file_info['content']
# Split lines, skip comments and empty lines
archived_songs = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " (case-insensitive)
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        archived_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # fallback: treat whole line as title
        archived_songs.append({'title': line.strip(), 'artists': []})

print(archived_songs)
